# Frontend Scoped Instructions

This scoped instruction file targets frontend code in `src/components/**/*.tsx` and provides framework-specific guidance for React/TypeScript component development.

- Prefer idiomatic React patterns and hooks.
- Use TypeScript interfaces/types for component props and state.
- Keep components small and focused.
- Avoid framework-agnostic suggestions that do not fit typical React/TypeScript component structure.
